definitions.gloss: material (of an object); quality or nature of a material
definitions.explanation: What an object is made of, and the properties of that material, such as wood, metal, plastic or cloth. Common in product descriptions.

examples.english: What is this chair made of?

examples.japanese: {材質|ざいしつ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コップ→コップ：00862_koppu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Depending on the material, cups of the same shape differ quite a lot in weight.

notes:
Often a heading on product labels: {材質|ざいしつ}：⟦ステンレス→ステンレス：08832_sutenresu⟧ (Material: stainless steel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {材質|ざいしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: made of good material
- {材質|ざいしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to be particular about materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: material, ingredient — the raw stuff itself, also used of food and of creative material
- ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧: materials, ingredients — what something is made from, seen before it is made
- ⟦{質感|しつかん}→質感：18028_shitsukan⟧: texture, feel — how a material looks and feels
